newsitem.title: USA: Infinity Inc posts Q3 profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: Infinity Inc posts Q3 profit vs loss.

text.p: Infinity Inc said Monday a strong emphasis on cost control helped the company post revenues of $1.2 million and net income of $12,729 for the third quarter ended December 31.
Infinity lost $199,400 in the same poeriod one year ago.

The company recently drilled five more wells on the 23,000 acres it owns in the Raton Basin. Infinty said it plans to drill an additional 10-15 wells in the spring of 1997, and may drill 80-90 more wells during the next phase of the project.
Infinity provides oilfield services. Its shares were trading up 1/8 Monday morning at 2-1/8.
